detail.longDescription: I am looking to create a mirror of my GitHub project to Codeberg. When initially migrating the repository through Codeberg, there's an option to migrate issues, pull requests, and labels . However, this appears to be a one-time migration, meaning any issues created on GitHub after the migration will not be mirrored. My goal is to create a read-only mirror of the GitHub repository on Codeberg as both a backup and a test run to see if a full migration may be worth doing in the future. I do not want to cut-off GitHub as the main contribution source just yet. How can I continue mirroring all future issues and pull requests from GitHub to Codeberg after the initial migration?
